final_payload.rationale_summary: The compare operation (call_index 11) computed the difference between the growth of United States exports goods/services and the mean growth for India and Mexico, yielding a difference of 9.81925611873844670784937087. The higher_ref identifies the mean of India and Mexico as having the higher growth. This result was cross-checked using supporting evidence from the finance knowledge graph and verified successfully.
